bosses.name: Timmy the Cruel
bosses.general: Appears in the market square once its undead are cleared: Ravenous Claw and he enrages.
bosses.tank: Plain tank, cooldowns at the end.

bosses.name: Cannon Master Willey
bosses.general: Calls Crimson Riflemen while he fights; Knock Away and Shoot.
bosses.tank: Back to a wall, grab the riflemen.
bosses.dps: Riflemen if they spread out, else Willey.

bosses.name: Archivist Galford
bosses.general: Fire Nova, Burning Winds and Pyroblast in the library.

bosses.name: Grand Crusader Dathrohan
bosses.general: Paladin who turns into the demon Balnazzar at half health: Shadow Shock, Psychic Scream, Sleep and Mind Control.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward or Tremor on you; pick him back up after the change.
bosses.healer: Dispel the sleep; crowd control or dispel the mind controlled.
bosses.dps: Burn him; don't kill a controlled friend.

bosses.name: Malor the Zealous
bosses.general: Guards the medallion in the Scarlet bastion. Holy spells and heals.

bosses.name: Hearthsinger Forresten
bosses.general: Rare bard: Disarm and Enchanting Lullaby.

bosses.name: Skul
bosses.general: Rare caster: Frostbolt and Arcane Bolt.

bosses.name: The Unforgiven
bosses.general: Spawns with Vengeful Phantoms: Frost Nova and Mind Numbing poison.
bosses.healer: Dispel the nova on the tank.

bosses.name: Baroness Anastari
bosses.general: Banshee: Possess takes over a player, Banshee Wail and Banshee Curse.
bosses.tank: Hold her; she ends Possess when she is hurt enough.
bosses.healer: Decurse; heal the possessed when it ends.
bosses.dps: Burn her, don't hurt the possessed friend.

bosses.name: Nerub'enkan
bosses.general: Crypt Scarabs swarm out, Encasing Webs root, Pierce Armor.
bosses.healer: Dispel the webs and the poison.
bosses.dps: Area attacks on the scarabs, then him.

bosses.name: Maleki the Pallid
bosses.general: Frostbolt, Drain Life and Ice Tomb on a player.

bosses.name: Magistrate Barthilas
bosses.general: Draining Blow, Crowd Pummel knocks back the melee, Mighty Blow.
bosses.tank: Face him away, back to a wall.
bosses.dps: From behind; the baron run timer starts at him.

bosses.name: Ramstein the Gorger
bosses.general: Abomination at the slaughterhouse: Trample and Knockout stun the tank. Black Guards come out after he dies.
bosses.tank: Get your threat back after the knockouts; grab the Black Guards after.
bosses.dps: Watch threat while the tank is stunned; then the guards.

bosses.name: Baron Rivendare
bosses.general: Raises skeletons and eats them with Death Pact to heal; Unholy Aura burns everyone near, Mortal Strike, Cleave.
bosses.tank: Face him away, grab the skeletons.
bosses.healer: Shadow damage on everyone: shadow resistance helps.
bosses.dps: Kill the skeletons quickly so he can't heal, then him.
